title: [spec-gap][R-07-006] CoT helper decoders skip PLI validation (py gateway trailing-byte tolerance; rust aprs_is.rs no range checks)
description: spec/07-transport-app.md:168: 'Receivers MUST reject PLI datagrams that are not exactly 17 bytes, coordinates outside the geographic ranges above, or courses greater than 35999.' Primary decoders conform+tested (python/src/lichen/compact_cot.py decode_pli:318 + PliPayload.__post_init__:128-136; rust/lichen-core/src/compact_cot.rs validate:168-179 on encode:517/decode:579; C compact_cot_pli.c validate_pli:17-29, -EMSGSIZE:114; vectors compact_cot.json pli_invalid_*). DIVERGENT helpers: (a) python/src/lichen/gateway/compact_cot.py:336-358 _decode_pli tolerates trailing bytes with warnings.warn (core py/Rs/C reject); (b) rust/lichen-gateway/src/aprs_is.rs:93 CompactCot::from_bytes rejects only len<17 and non-PLI subtype - no lat/lon/course range validation, accepts trailing bytes (used on the APRS translation path). Suggested placement: route both helpers through the validating core decoders (lichen-core CompactCot/PliPayload) instead of duplicating parse logic; add negative vectors for gateway + aprs paths.
